All six stances, the quotes and the 6-1 come from one KTUU story dated September 29th; the deck credits the 6-1 to the station. 26 miles is true of Eielson only; JBER and Clear are much farther. Fifth deck in about 30 days to touch the Air Force lease lane. Art rose 7.0 to 7.5 on the one craft-floor cycle and stays under the 8.5 floor.
